purpose: Teach: トレーダー/地蔵/グランプリ/怪獣/三昧/言うまでもなく/このごろ/スキン

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは株のトレーダーになろうとされたぞ
lines.en: Your father wanted to be a stock trader when he was young, you know.
lines.style: Soft, nostalgic opening. Gentle, slightly distant tone — reaching back into memory. Measured pace, unhurried. Settles on each image like settling into an old chair.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、村の入り口の地蔵によくお参りされたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: He did, didn't he? And you'd visit that stone Buddha at the village entrance so often back then.
lines.style: Warm, teasing undercurrent. Conversational, almost conspiratorial — gently redirecting him. Bright eyes in the voice. A small laugh waiting just underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが映画のグランプリに感動されたぞ
lines.en: Your father was so moved by that film prize when he was young.
lines.style: Same wistful register as before. A separate memory surfacing — unrushed. Quieter on 'film prize,' like he's picturing it. Voice trails into the distance slightly.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、子供たちに怪獣の絵を描いてあげたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: He would draw those monster pictures for the children, wouldn't he?
lines.style: Playful, knowing warmth. She's not correcting him so much as reminding him of what he already knows. Light, almost singing the words. A smile in her voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは読書三昧の休日を過ごされたぞ
lines.en: Your father spent entire days lost in books during his time off.
lines.style: Same gentle, memory-bound tone. The phrase 'entire days' lingers slightly — capturing the abundance of those hours. Wistful but peaceful, not sad.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お父さんを言うまでもなく尊敬されてたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And your father — well, of course you respected him deeply, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, knowing. Not a question that needs answering. She's stating a truth she knows he'll recognize. Soft, affirming tone. A little nod in her voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、このごろ若い頃の思い出をよく語りたくなるぞ
lines.en: I find myself wanting to talk about those days more and more lately.
lines.style: Quieter than before. A shift — less reaching into memory, more sitting with a gentle realization. Slower pace. Tender, slightly vulnerable. The words land with quiet weight.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お肌のスキンケアもなさってたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: You always took such good care of yourself then too, didn't you?
lines.style: Light, affectionate, almost playful. A gentle ribbing wrapped in warmth. Close, intimate — the voice of someone who's known him a very long time. Bright underneath.
